name: cavemio-theme-toggle
title: Theme Toggle
description: Switch between a sun and crescent moon inside one circular button.

cavemio.accessibility: Native button with a destination label, pressed state, keyboard activation, visible focus, disabled behavior, and live reduced-motion support.
cavemio.previewNote: The reference demo synchronizes icon, pill, and segmented controls on its own card, including a circular reveal. Selecting System follows the operating system. The website theme stays independent. Existing theme/onThemeChange/pageTransition integrations remain supported.

props.name: defaultTheme
props.description: Initial uncontrolled appearance. Defaults to light.

props.name: onThemeChange
props.description: Receives the next appearance when activated. The host owns document theme and persistence.

props.name: pageTransition
props.description: Defaults to none. Circular opts into a 620ms document reveal and keeps button scale stable. onThemeChange must apply theme styles synchronously; reduced motion or unavailable transitions switch immediately.

props.name: size
props.description: Button diameter in pixels. Defaults to 48, with a minimum 44px hit area.

props.name: className / style
props.description: Customize the button surface and dimensions.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Override the default destination label. Native button props are forwarded.

props.name: nonce
props.description: Optional CSP nonce for the temporary transition stylesheet. Use your server-generated allowed style nonce.

props.name: variant
props.description: Opt into the reference control API and appearance. Defaults to icon when the reference API is selected.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial appearance for the reference variants. Pair value with onValueChange.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Receives the reference variant selection. A controlled host applies the theme.

props.name: storageKey / attribute / reveal
props.description: Reference variants: uncontrolled persistence key, document theme marker, and optional circular reveal. See the reference variant documentation for defaults.
